defs.def: an organization of workers, usually in a particular industry, that exists to protect their interests, improve conditions of work, etc. 工会

ex.s: But at Union Station in Los Angeles last month, a board went up with dollar bills attached to it with pins and a sign that read, "Give What You Can, Take What You Need."
ex.t: 但上个月在洛杉矶联合车站，一块板子竖了起来，上面用别针别着美元钞票，还有一个牌子写着："尽你所能给予，按你所需取用。"

defs.def: an association or a club for people or organizations with the same interest 协会；联合会；会社；俱乐部
a group of states or countries that have the same central government or that agree to work together 同盟；联盟；联邦

ex.s: The French take their 35-hour workweek seriously — so seriously that some labor unions recently struck a deal with a group of companies limiting the number of hours that independent contractors can be on call.
ex.t: A.并非所有顾客都是游客。

defs.def: the US (used especially at the time of the Civil War) （尤指内战时期的）美利坚合众国，美国

ex.s: The World Triathlon Series is held by the International Triathlon Union.
ex.t: 世界铁人三项系列赛由国际铁人三项联盟举办。

ex.s: For two years, its people had been deep in a civil war between the slave-owning Confederate Southern States and the “free” Northern States of the Union.
ex.t: 两年来，它的人民深陷于蓄奴的南方邦联各州与“自由”的北方联邦各州之间的内战。

ex.s: The Union side won, but at a great cost.
ex.t: 联邦一方取胜，但代价惨重。

ex.s: Hu Ming manages student union affairs.
They use the same flag, known as the Union Jack, as well as share the same currency and military defence.
ex.t: 他们使用同一面旗帜，即“米字旗”（Union Jack），并共用同一种货币和军事防御。

defs.def: the act of joining two or more things together; the state of being joined together; the act of two people joining together 联合；结合；合并
a marriage 结为夫妻；婚姻
